provenance.note:
All 53 base-game civs (data.json's civs map, era "base" only — the source has no other era for civs). Each entry carries its raw EN+TR 'help' string (civ bonuses, unique unit(s), unique techs, team bonus —
-separated, '•'-bulleted, section headers per language), keyed by (LanguageHelpId) civ.help_string_id, sourced straight from strings-en.json/strings-tr.json at the same pinned SHA. refdata::civs parses these with the same section-marker logic as the old scripts/lib/parse-help.mjs. Keyed by data.json's OWN civs object key (e.g. "Hindustanis", not "Indians" — that is civ.internal_name's value, carried here for reference only).

Armenians.help_en:

• Mule Carts cost -25%

• Spearman- and Militia-line upgrades (except Man-at-Arms) available one age earlier
